question: From Figure 2B-1, identify the shapes of the STOP and YIELD signs and the color scheme of the ALL-WAY plaque.
model_answer: Direct Answer: In Figure 2B-1, the STOP (R1-1) sign is an octagon (red background with white legend and border), and the YIELD (R1-2) sign is a downward-pointing equilateral triangle (red band with white interior and red YIELD legend). The ALL-WAY (R1-3P) plaque has a white legend and border on a red background. Standards (mandatory): - "At intersections where all approaches are controlled by STOP signs (see Section 2B.12), an ALL-WAY (R1-3P) supplemental plaque (see Figure 2B-1) shall be mounted below each STOP sign. The ALL-WAY plaque shall have a white legend and border on a red background." - "When it is determined that a full stop is always required on an approach to an intersection, a STOP (R1-1) sign (see Figure 2B-1) shall be used." - "The YIELD (R1-2) sign (see Figure 2B-1) shall not be displayed using a changeable message sign." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 2B-1 shows the STOP (R1-1) sign as a red octagon with white legend, the YIELD (R1-2) sign as a red-and-white downward-pointing triangle, and the ALL-WAY (R1-3P) plaque as a small horizontal rectangle with white "ALL WAY" legend and border on a red background. - [Image 2] Page 115 (Section 2B.04/2B.05 text with Figure 2B-1) confirms the same shapes and colors: octagonal STOP sign, triangular YIELD sign, and red ALL-WAY plaque with white legend. - [Image 3] Page 1015 (Figure 7B-1) shows the same octagonal STOP and triangular YIELD symbols reproduced within school crossing signs, consistent with Figure 2B-1. - [Image 4] Page 835 (Figure 6G-1) again depicts the R1-1 as a red octagon and the R1-2 as a red-and-white triangle in temporary traffic control applications. - [Image 5] Page 159 (Figure 2B-20) shows octagonal STOP signs in an intersection signing layout, consistent with the R1-1 shape shown in Figure 2B-1. Citations: - Section 2B.04 Standard §4 (p.74) - Section 2B.04 Standard §1 (p.74) - Section 2B.05 Standard §2 (p.75) - Figure 2B-1 (p.74) - Page 115
gold_answer: STOP is an octagon; YIELD is a downward-pointing equilateral triangle; the ALL-WAY plaque has white legend and border on a red background.
